fields.description: Charge per motherstock pot per month.
fields.label: Pot Holding Rate Per Month

fields.description: Plantech's own order-to-delivery time. The protocol lead time covers on-farm establishment only, so this is added on top to get the order date.
fields.label: Lab Turnaround Weeks

fields.description: Plantech multiplication bands. Rates are per plantlet.
fields.label: TC Price Bands

fields.description: Physical ceiling on the motherstock pool. Without it, diverting cuttings every week compounds without bound.
fields.label: Available Bench (m²)

fields.description: Defaults for the Material Requests raised for crop inputs. Material Request is the order sheet; these are only the site-specific fields it makes mandatory and cannot derive.
fields.label: Input Requests

fields.description: Mandatory on Material Request at this site.
fields.label: Default Business Unit

fields.description: Chemical and Fertiliser Issuing request types are used when the request is type-specific.
fields.label: Default Request Type

fields.description: Copied onto each Material Request line, which requires it at this site.
fields.label: Default Line Purpose

fields.description: An approved fixed-asset item to raise standing-crop assets against. Leave empty to create one per variety, which then has to go through item approval before an asset can be raised.
fields.label: Biological Asset Item

fields.description: Comma separated. Purchases of items in these groups are plant material: they get the incoming inspection and update the planting's received quantity.
fields.label: Plant Item Groups

fields.description: Defaulted onto plant items, so an inspection is offered without anyone choosing a template.
fields.label: Plant Inspection Template

fields.description: A short or over delivery inside this band is treated as fully received and nobody is alerted.
fields.label: Delivery Tolerance %

fields.description: ERPNext only enforces an incoming inspection on an invoice that updates stock. With this on, a plant line on any submitted Purchase Invoice needs one.
fields.label: Require Inspection on Invoice

fields.description: How a season starts, as relative weights per week -- the plant is not giving in its first producing week what it gives in its fifth. Normalised across the productive weeks, so the same shape fits a short season and a long one.
fields.label: Season curve: build-up weights

fields.description: How a season ends, as relative weights per week. Leave both empty and the season is flat.
fields.label: Season curve: tail-off weights
